svg.title: AI Support Agent — Support automation · function calling
svg.desc: Feature 5 of 6: AI Support Agent — Support automation · function calling. Status: built. Answers the routine questions; hands people the rest with context. Claude / GPT-4o with function calling classifies every inbound query by intent and urgency, resolves the routine ones and escalates the rest with the context already drafted. Fig. 8, how a query is routed: 1. Classify — intent + urgency; 2. Resolve — auto-reply, logged to the CRM; 3. Escalate — human review, context pre-drafted. Stack: Node.js, Claude, GPT-4o, Supabase, Webhooks.
